verdict.rationale: v0's pricing docs describe the plan structure: Premium at $20/month with higher limits, extra credits purchasable on Premium, Plus and Business, and a shared team credit pool. The API docs note that starting from existing files uses no tokens. There is no evidence of a per-action breakdown of credit or token consumption, and a community report of unexpectedly high usage-based spend suggests consumption is hard to predict. Missing for 10: a per-action credit/token cost breakdown, a detailed list of what each plan includes in credits and limits, usage tracking or visibility tooling, and independent confirmation that costs are understandable.
